skill.name: Snapshot
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to deploy <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. A cursor will move along the <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. 
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button when the cursor falls outside of <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button when the cursor falls within <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>, dealing increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring additional <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color> instead of deploying <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.
<color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> continues to expand when <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> and automatically collapses when fills the whole <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>, triggering <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>.
Holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3</color> in sequence, and deploys <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Shortly after performing this attack, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> deploys a <color=Highlight>ring</color>.
Landing the cursor within the <color=Highlight>highlight area</color> allows Lucilla to deal increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restore additional <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

skill.name: Phantom Frame
skill.desc:
Pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While casting this skill, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deploy <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. A cursor will move along the <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button when the cursor falls outside of <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Compensate</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button when the cursor falls within <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will cast <color=Highlight>Spotlight</color>, dealing increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring additional <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
If Lucilla casts the skill on-field without holding <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, she directly casts <color=Highlight>Compensate</color> instead of deploying <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Compensate</color></size>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and reducing the remaining Cooldown of Lucilla's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> by {0}.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Spotlight</color></size>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Spotlight</color>, Lucilla additionally restores <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Concerto Energy, and inflicts <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> extra {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> onto the target if she is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>. Switching to another Resonatore ends the effect.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deploy a <color=Highlight>ring</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Landing the cursor within the <color=Highlight>highlight area</color> allows Lucilla to cast <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color>, dealing increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring additional <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Resonance Skill</color>, Lucilla additionally restores Concerto Energy. While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, Lucilla can inflict <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> on targets.

skill.name: Clear As Day
skill.desc:
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Reminiscence</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, the DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Casting this skill grants Lucilla {0} Basic Attack DMG Bonus for {1}s.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, the DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>. Casting this skill grants Lucilla {0} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {1}s.
When in <color=Highlight>Reminiscence</color>, Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Reminiscence</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut</color> respectively.
Can be performed in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms</color></size>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target.
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or finishing the whole <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color> automatically casts <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Letting It Go</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>/<color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color> is immune to interruption, and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.
Casting <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=110905>Reminiscence</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Reminiscence</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Shortly after performimg this attack, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Enhanced State</color>.

skill.name: Slow Motion
skill.desc:
While deploying <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>, Lucilla slows targets within her camera coverage.
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame</color> to deploy<color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>, if the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button is released when the cursor falls within the <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, Glacio RES of targets around the active Resonator is reduced by {0} for {1}s. Enemies defeated by <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> DMG during this time is credited to the nearest active Resonator.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, Resonators in the team gain {2} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {3}s.
These enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.

- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, Resonators in the team gain Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

Each time Lucilla consumes <color=Highlight>Photos</color>, she gains certain stacks of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement</color>.

skill.name: Memory Palace
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Déjà Vu</color></size>
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, gain <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=110903>Film Roll</te></color> for {1}s, stacking up {2} times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, gain <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of <color=Highlight><te href=110904>Zoom</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up {8} times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.

<size=40><color=Title>Film Roll</color></size>
When Resonators besides Lucilla inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> onto the target, Lucilla consumes <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of <color=Highlight>Film Roll</color> to inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=time SapTag=4} on the target. This effect can be triggered once every {5}s.

<size=40><color=Title>Zoom</color></size>
Each stack of <color=Highlight>Zoom</color> increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by {9}.

<size=40><color=Title>Oblivion</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color> consumes 1 <color=Highlight><te href=110902>Photo</te></color> to perform <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color>, dealing 1 instance of <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of Concerto Energy:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, this instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. The skill inflicts <SapTag=B>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=B} of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on the target.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, this instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>. The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color> cast during <color=Highlight><te href=110905>Reminiscence</te></color> are considered Echo Skills not of the same name. 

<size=40><color=Title>Quick Glance</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, collectibles, and specific items within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the shutter to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.

<size=40><color=Title>Trace</color></size>
Lucilla can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color>.
Restore <SapTag=C>{13}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It</color>.
Restore <SapTag=D>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Spotlight</color>.
Restore <SapTag=D>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>.
Restore <SapTag=E>{15}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Compensate</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Photos</color></size>
Lucilla can hold up to {16} <color=Highlight>Photos</color>.
Every <SapTag=F>{17}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color> restored generates 1 <color=Highlight>Photo</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Forte Gauge</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> restores <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> restores <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color>. Landing the cursor within the <color=Highlight>highlight area</color> increases the restoration amount.
For every certain amount of <color=Highlight>Forte Gauge</color> restored, generate 1 <color=Highlight>Photo</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode Enhancements</color></size>
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, Lucilla gains certain stacks of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement</color>. When Resonators besides Lucilla inflict <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> onto the target, Lucilla consumes <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement</color> to inflict additional <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> on the target.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, Lucilla gains certain stacks of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement</color>. Each stack of <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement</color> increases the Crit. DMG of Echo Skill for all Resonators in the team.

<size=40><color=Title>Photo Attack</color></size>
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Enhanced State Stage 3</color>, Lucilla consumes <color=Highlight>Photos</color> to restore Concerto Energy and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, inflict <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color> onto the target hit.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, casting this skill is considered as casting Echo Skills not of the same name.
